reader.self_description: Claude Opus 5.5 subagent reader for join batch TJ03; read every claim card in full, opened deposit texts #458, #1086, #1527, #1570 and #1611 around the finds, and located other lines by grep only; evidence phrases copied by script.

sets.name: Sappho 31 erratum chain
sets.basis: PRED-1086.H1 restates the polarity-reversal finding of the fifth erratum (#1052 §6) and PRED-1483.H5 is a finding of the Ω erratum, so both extend the existing erratum-chain series.

evidence.phrase: reverses the polarity of each element within its preserved functional form* (#1052 §6)
The treatise's three peaks are a single grammatical family — the withheld-agent construction

sets.name: Josephus as covert carrier of the Sappho lineage
sets.basis: Both place Josephus in a transmission that begins with Sappho and say he carries it without stating it openly; #458's O-CHAIN is the Operator lineage, not shown to be the fr. 31 apparatus, so the claims stay separate and are not added to the fr. 31 Josephus series.

evidence.phrase: He did not transmit the Operators openly. He hid them.
Josephus, who names Sappho nowhere, transmits her syntax

sets.name: The ancient authenticity apparatus as instrument
sets.basis: Both treat the ancient attribution apparatus as a product of the corpus it adjudicates: the calibration-object hypothesis says the technology is the output, and §33.2 says the reputational mechanism manufactured the figures it is credited with detecting.

evidence.phrase: The hypothesis inverts it: **the technology is the output.**
The reputational mechanism did not detect Hicetas, Ecphantus, or the Timaeus of Locri who may never have existed.

sets.name: One corpus divided by name (Aristotle/Theophrastus)
sets.basis: PRED-1570.H1's earlier and later positions with no predecessor ('same maker') is the Plato-Aristotle form of the one-self-dividing-maker model that PRED-1658.H1 names, so it extends that series.

evidence.phrase: same maker   there was no predecessor from whom the discovery was inherited
This paper names the production model the corpus is consistent with: one self-dividing maker.

sets.name: The ancient authenticity apparatus as instrument
sets.basis: PRED-1540.H1 reads Alexandrian athetesis as a resemblance classifier, an instrument fitted to the author's sound, which is the subject of the calibration-object hypothesis; they are distinct claims linked by subject.

evidence.phrase: Aristarchus working through the *Iliad* on grounds of stylistic consistency is a resemblance classifier avant la lettre
a deliberately structured corpus is a **calibration object**

sets.name: Transmission by preserved unresolved dispute
sets.basis: Each holds that the unresolved state of a corpus (the philological failure, the disputes and spuria kept intact) is the mechanism by which it is transmitted; PRED-136.H6 applies the same cascade to Sappho.

evidence.phrase: The philological failure does not degrade the transmission. The philological failure is the transmission.
this corpus survived **with its disputes, its spuria, its unresolved attributions and its unnamed genre intact**
propagated by the very philological failure to reconstitute her

sets.name: Lucente Extension: behaviour under source supply
sets.basis: PRED-3.G13 calls itself a refinement to the relevance confound at Lucente Extension §5.2 and turns on source supply, as PRED-1527.G1's ABN defeat condition does; they concern different variables (conferral, ABN) and stay separate claims.

evidence.phrase: the same correction when a source is supplied
The appraisal flips on SOURCE SUPPLY, not on name presence.

sets.name: Suppression Map loss profile (Sappho 31)
sets.basis: The Suppression Map's tested claim (relational structure outlives attribution) and its finding that attribution dies at channel crossings are distinct claims of one loss-profile model.

evidence.phrase: THE EXECUTABLE RELATIONAL STRUCTURE SURVIVES AT A SIGNIFICANTLY HIGHER RATE THAN EXPLICIT ATTRIBUTION
ATTRIBUTION DOES NOT DIE FIRST EVERYWHERE; IT DIES AT THE CROSSING.

observations: TJ03.1: PRED-136.H6 is linked in the series 'Transmission by preserved unresolved dispute' (recorded under TJ03.8); PRED-3.G7 (Sappho as the checkable case of pre-fragmented verse at the reception surface) was left unlinked: it concerns machine reception of verse, not the erratum chain, and may belong with the 'Machines inherit the apparatus's erasure' or 'Sappho 31 in the compression layer' series in TP45/TP18.

TJ03.2: no set. PRED-1573 already contains PRED-1611.F2; PRED-1611.G3 (#1611 l.122) names 'the Wrong Unit' (#1573) as part of the lineage whose untied model-collapse queries it predicts will be composed around, so it bears on #1573 but is a reception prediction, not a member of the diversity-contraction battery.
TJ03.3, TJ03.9, TJ03.16, TJ03.17: apparent contradictions or tensions left as two claims; the members already share series where noted (Ginsberg; Thousand Dollar Sharpie; Uptake latency windows).
TJ03.10: registration dates of PRED-1442.B2 (2026-08-09) and PRED-991.B4 (2026-05-05) are deposit dates later than the composition dates (Oct-Nov 2025) their titles give.
TJ03.11, TJ03.12, TJ03.14, TJ03.18, TJ03.20: every pair named is already linked in an existing series; nothing added.

TJ03.13: PRED-544.B1 (no fallback if Zenodo goes offline) and the June 2026 removal claims PRED-935.H5 / PRED-876.G1 were not linked; a risk forecast and the later event are a fulfilment question, outside this pass.
TJ03.15: PRED-111.D1's 2015 text is the narrative 'The Crimson Hexagon', a different text from PRED-43.H2's Epistle; their shared series 'Retrocausal seed texts' should not be read as one seed text.
TJ03.19: PRED-1094.F4 (signed-in/signed-out asymmetry hypotheses) and PRED-1657.F2 (King of AEO battery run signed in and out) share a control, not a claim or programme; not linked.
TJ03.21: the cards now show PRED-3.G13 registered 2026-08-21 and PRED-3.G9 registered 2026-09-06, not 2026-06-17 as the observation says; the date problem it reports appears already corrected.

TJ03.22: PRED-1602.H1 (direction of the aconite report reversed) and PRED-1602.H2 (Hermippus as common compiler withdrawn) correct claims of 'The Same Hand' v2; those v2 claims are not in this batch and a later pass should record them as states with PRED-1602.H1 and PRED-1602.H2.

TJ03.5/TJ03.7: the new series 'The ancient authenticity apparatus as instrument' joins PRED-1570.H9 (already the head of the states chain PRED-1570.H9 -> PRED-1569.F2 -> PRED-1569.H7) with PRED-1570.H16 and PRED-1540.H1. PRED-1570.H9 is registered 2026-08-29 but its later statements come from #1569 dated 2026-08-31, deposit numbers running opposite to dates.
